summary: The narrator, shaken by the deaths of Anton and Penny, the two people who looked things up for him, considers whether an old grudge or his own job caused the attack. He presses Courtney, his client, about what the men at her home were searching for, but she insists she does not know. He drives her to a bolt hole while she cries, and their argument ends with her shocked realization that the danger began only that morning.
one_line: A fiction excerpt in which a hard-bitten investigator, grieving two dead information workers, pressures his frightened client Courtney while fleeing pursuers.
key_facts: The narrator's job was supposed to be easy: rescue the kid, get her out of the country, and be home in time for dinner.
Whoever targeted Anton had overcompensated to take all of his data and information with them.
The narrator considers that a case from months or years ago, such as an old client with a grudge, might have provoked the attack.
The narrator's client is on the run from the authorities, a drug cartel that wants her dead, government men in dark suits, a dirty cop, and an unknown player willing to commit arson and murder.
The narrator has lost his information broker, Penny, a twelve-year-old kick-ass hacker who was taught to pay her taxes on time.
Courtney cries softly in the passenger seat the whole way to the bolt hole the narrator drives them to.
The narrator asks Courtney, "What aren't you telling me?" and "Those men at your place were looking for something. What was it?"
Courtney answers, "I don't—I don't know. I swear I don't."
A message arrives from Yuki saying, "I'm lactose intolerant," and nothing more.
The narrator swings the car into a grimy alleyway and tells Courtney, "You didn't even know them."
Courtney asks, "How can you be so cold?" and the narrator asks whether she is feeling guilty.
Courtney reacts in horror: "This was about us? Oh, God—that was only this morning!"
The narrator admits he is not any good with people.

entities.name: Anton
entities.role: Person whose search for information was noticed by the attackers; his work and data were taken by whoever targeted him, and he died.

entities.name: Courtney
entities.role: The narrator's client, the kid he is rescuing, who is on the run and hiding information about the men at her place.

entities.name: Yuki
entities.role: Sender of a message saying "I'm lactose intolerant" during the flight.

entities.name: Penny
entities.role: Twelve-year-old kick-ass hacker and the narrator's information broker, who is lost and presumed dead.

entities.name: Drug cartel
entities.role: Criminal group that wants Courtney dead.

entities.name: Bolt hole
entities.role: Hiding place the narrator drives Courtney to.
